text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ فِى ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle opening the ayah and scoping the disclosed strategy
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) makes restriction the ayah's entry-frame: the adversary's purpose is not left open-ended, but narrowed to the strategy that follows. Its fused form cancels ordinary emphasis-governance and works as pure restriction. Because the same opener framed the preceding verdict in 5:90, the reader hears a two-step argument: 5:90 names what the items are, and 5:91 discloses what they are used to do. The scope then stretches across a balanced distribution: two social harms, enmity and hatred, and two devotional targets, remembrance and prayer.

topics.headline: restriction covers the full strategy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens by narrowing the adversary's disclosed purpose before the agent or harms are even named.
topics.reason: The fused particle is identified as a restrictive opener whose scope extends over both purpose clauses.

topics.headline: paired restriction links verdict to rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 5:91 as the explanation half of a two-ayah argument begun by the same restrictive opener in 5:90.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows explicitly link the repeated restrictive opener in 5:90 and 5:91, moving from classification to rationale.

topics.headline: restriction introduces balanced social and devotional harms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restricted strategy is distributed across social rupture and devotional blockage rather than a single vague harm.
topics.reason: The ayah architecture and sound row support the opening as a compact frame for the two later damage-pairs.

words.gloss_range: ongoing directed intent governing the purpose complement
words.root_gloss_range: seeking and directed volition; locally the Form IV imperfect selects purposeful willing
words.prose: {{ar:يُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:yurīdu}}) gives the restriction a governing action: the adversary is continuously intending, not merely having once wished. The root-range of directed seeking remains felt, while the Form IV imperfect selects purposeful aim toward the following objectives. Within Surah 5, this will-language contrasts with divine will in 5:1 and 5:6, so the word functions as an adversarial counter-will. Its position moves the discourse from the prior verdict into a causal diagnosis of strategy.

topics.headline: ongoing directed will, not loose desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an active, continuing purpose rather than a one-time wish or incidental effect.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form IV verb governs the following complement and the supplied lexicon narrows desire into directed intent.

topics.headline: satanic will set against divine will in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same will-language used for divine ordering elsewhere in Surah 5 is here assigned to the adversary as a counter-will.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence rows link 5:1 and 5:6 with the adversarial use in 5:91.

topics.headline: verb launches the disclosed strategy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from verdict to causal diagnosis as soon as the governing verb appears.
topics.reason: The verb follows the restriction and precedes the named agent, organizing everything after it as exposed strategy.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative adversary as named agent of the strategy
words.root_gloss_range: remoteness from good, with a secondary inflaming image kept as coloring rather than the local derivation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ}} ({{tr:ash-shayṭānu}}) supplies the named subject of the exposed will. The definite nominative form prevents the strategy from becoming an impersonal consequence of the practices alone. The remoteness-root image also fits the local action: the remote adversary works by making people remote from remembrance and prayer, while producing enmity among them. The enemy-agent thus reproduces his own enmity in human relationships rather than merely causing a neutral separation. Across the boundary from 5:90, the one named as source of the work is now promoted into active strategist.

topics.headline: definite nominative adversary fixes agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the harms are assigned to a named agent, not to vague social circumstance alone.
topics.reason: Nominative role, definiteness, and singular form identify the known adversary as subject of the restricted intent.

topics.headline: remote adversary produces distance and enmity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adversary named by remoteness acts by producing distance from remembrance and enmity among people.
topics.reason: The remoteness derivation is locally coherent; the burning derivation is kept as secondary coloring for inflamed hostility rather than replacing the main root image.

topics.headline: prior source becomes active subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from the adversary as source of the prior work in 5:90 to active subject in 5:91.
topics.reason: CRITICAL boundary rows explicitly track the shift from genitive source to nominative subject.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive and verbal-noun complement marker for the intended objectives
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the following actions into the content of the adversary's will. It subordinates the first verb and carries forward to the later blocking verb, so social fracture and devotional obstruction sit inside one intended program. Its payoff is syntactic: the strategy is not two loose statements but one complement frame.

topics.headline: one complement frame contains both objectives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two harmful outcomes are grammatically one program of intent rather than separate warnings.
topics.reason: The particle opens the verbal-noun-like complement of the will and its governance carries through both purpose verbs.

words.gloss_range: causative making-happen or causing-to-fall in the interpersonal space
words.root_gloss_range: falling, landing, occurring, and impact; locally Form IV selects causative infliction
words.prose: {{ar:يُوقِعَ}} ({{tr:yūqiʿa}}) is not neutral occurrence. The causative form makes the adversary the one who causes the event to land, and the next word turns the addressees' between-space into the landing zone. The supplied rows mark this as the only Form IV occurrence for this root, so the grammar does not merely say conflict happens; it makes engineered occurrence the adversary's marked action. The marked form therefore makes social rupture feel deposited into relationship, not simply arising by accident. As the first subjunctive objective under the complement marker, it stages the strategy before the two abstract harms are named.

topics.headline: causative fall lands harm in the between-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that enmity is pictured as something made to land in the relational space between the addressees.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb and direct following place-adverb support causative deposition into the between-space.

topics.headline: marked Form IV occurrence sharpens agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form does not merely say conflict happens; it assigns the making-happen to the adversary.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows identify the causative form as marked and contrast it with simple occurrence.

topics.headline: first intended objective stages action, site, and objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first objective as a staged action: caused event, relational site, then named social harms.
topics.reason: The subjunctive depends on the complement marker and begins the first purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: the addressees' between-space as the targeted relational zone
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinction, clarity, and between-ness; locally the spatial-relational branch is active
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَكُمُ}} ({{tr:baynakumu}}) marks the relational target of the causative verb: the harm is made to fall among the addressees, in the space between them. The attached plural suffix begins a chain in which the same audience is first the fractured relationship, then the blocked object, and finally the subject asked to answer. The broader separation-and-distinction root image is narrowed to local between-ness, but it still sharpens the sense of relations being split and the clarity of proper distinction being corrupted.

topics.headline: between-space becomes the target zone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attack is aimed at the space among people, before the abstract harms are named.
topics.reason: The place-adverb role and direct placement after the causative verb make the between-space the immediate target.

topics.headline: the second-person chain begins in relationship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same addressees first as relational space, later as obstruction object, and finally as answer-bearing subject.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows track the 2mp suffix chain from this word through the closing question.

topics.headline: between-ness carries separation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root-range of distinction and separation deepens the local image of relations being split apart.
topics.reason: The local sense remains the adverbial between-space, while broader clarity and separation branches color the relational target.

words.gloss_range: definite abstract enmity as the first object caused to land
words.root_gloss_range: crossing a boundary, hostility, aggression, and transgression; locally moralized social enmity is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadāwata}}) is the first named object made to land in the between-space. Its definiteness and abstract form name enmity as a recognizable social state, while the root image of boundary-crossing makes that state morally charged. The word also joins a same-surah fracture pattern: enmity is placed among groups in 5:14 and 5:64, and here that placement is disclosed as part of the adversary's objective.

topics.headline: definite abstract enmity as caused object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices enmity as a named social state being placed among people, not as a vague mood.
topics.reason: Accusative object role, definiteness, and abstract noun form support this object reading.

topics.headline: hostility as transgressive boundary crossing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the enmity carries a moral boundary-crossing image, while the local noun still names the abstract state.
topics.reason: The root image of crossing and hostility is coherent but is narrowed to the abstract social state governed by the verb.

topics.headline: enmity formula recurs within Surah 5
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:91 joins a same-surah pattern where enmity is cast into the space between groups (5:14; 5:64).
topics.reason: Concrete echo rows cite 5:14 and 5:64 as same-surah fracture parallels.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining the two social-fracture objects
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the first harm open for a second coordinated object. The conjunction makes the two social fractures share one causative verb while remaining distinct: enmity is not collapsed into hatred, and hatred is not treated as a mere restatement of enmity.

topics.headline: coordination preserves two social harms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hatred is added as a coordinated partner, not swallowed into enmity as a synonym.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two objects under the same causative verb while preserving their distinct semantic roles.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive hatred as the second social-fracture object
words.root_gloss_range: aversion, hatred, and repulsion; locally the intensive abstract state is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَغْضَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-baghḍāʾa}}) supplies the second social object: a definite, intensive abstract of hatred. It pairs with enmity as inner aversion alongside outward hostility, so the fracture is both relational and affective. The rare same-surah return from 5:14 and 5:64 keeps this from sounding like generic dislike; it belongs to a recurring fracture formula.

topics.headline: intensive hatred as coordinated object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second harm names intense aversion, not ordinary dislike.
topics.reason: The coordinated accusative role and intensive abstract pattern support the retained payoff.

topics.headline: enmity and hatred form outer-inner fracture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a paired damage field: outward hostility and inward aversion precede the devotional blockage.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows treat the pair as formulaic and distinguish external hostility from internal repulsion.

topics.headline: rare hatred term returns from same-surah fractures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare term returns from 5:14 and 5:64 inside the same fracture vocabulary.
topics.reason: Echo rows cite the rare recurrence and same-surah pairing with enmity.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the medium of operation through the named practices
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) pivots the first objective from the social harms to the instruments by which they operate. The local force is narrowed toward instrumentality: the following practices are the medium through which enmity and hatred are made to work. The ordinary locative feel is not erased, so the reader can still hear the harms as embedded in those practices.

topics.headline: medium through which the harm operates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named practices are not merely where enmity appears but the medium through which the strategy works.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supports instrumental attachment to the causative verb, while locative pressure remains compatible with the preposition.

topics.headline: preposition pivots from harms to instruments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the syntax turning from the produced social harms to the mechanisms that produce them.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase mediates between the first objective and the named practices.

words.gloss_range: intoxication as the first named medium and mechanism
words.root_gloss_range: covering, veiling, fermenting, and concealment; locally the mind-covering intoxicant is the operative sense
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَمْرِ}} ({{tr:al-khamri}}) is now genitive inside the instrumental phrase, so the item named in 5:90 becomes a mechanism in 5:91. The root image of covering is locally narrowed to the intoxicant, but it matters because cognitive covering explains how remembrance and prayer can be obstructed. The contrast with 47:15 keeps the lexical claim context-bound: this worldly use is condemned as an instrument of harm, while the same noun can appear differently in another setting.

topics.headline: intoxicant as covering mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that intoxication functions as a mind-covering mechanism that helps explain the later blockage from remembrance.
topics.reason: The root covering image is locally narrowed to the intoxicant governed by the preposition, not every branch of covering.

topics.headline: prior verdict item becomes causal instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from a prohibited item in 5:90 to an operating mechanism in 5:91.
topics.reason: Boundary rows explicitly mark the movement from verdict member to causal medium.

topics.headline: worldly instrument contrasted with 47:15 usage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local condemnation belongs to this worldly mechanism, not to every occurrence of the same noun across contexts.
topics.reason: The 47:15 contrast blocks an absolute lexical overreading while preserving the local negative mechanism.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining the two instrumental nouns
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) holds the instrumental frame open for a second named practice. The coordination pairs the two mechanisms under one preposition while keeping them distinct: one covers judgment, the other promises easy gain.

topics.headline: coordination pairs two mechanisms without merging them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two distinct mechanisms working under one instrumental frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second genitive noun under the same preposition while preserving mechanism difference.

words.gloss_range: gambling or easy-gain practice as the second named medium
words.root_gloss_range: ease, facilitation, lot-casting, and easy gain; locally the forbidden game-of-chance institution is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَيْسِرِ}} ({{tr:al-maysiri}}) completes the instrument pair as the coordinated genitive partner of intoxication. Its root-range of ease is narrowed to gambling or chance-practice, and that narrowing creates the payoff: the promised ease becomes the trap. In the pair, intoxication covers individual judgment while gambling disrupts collective fairness through gain without labor. The contrast with 2:185 keeps ease itself from being condemned; what is exposed here is a false facilitation that operates as a satanic medium.

topics.headline: ease root becomes gambling as trap
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a word from ease names a practice whose ease becomes a trap.
topics.reason: The ease branch is real, but local grammar and legal context narrow it to the named gambling or chance-practice.

topics.headline: second instrument closes the medium phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase closing on the second mechanism, completing the pair through which the social harms operate.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated with the prior instrument and closes the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: prohibited ease contrasted with divine ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a contrast between false easy gain here and beneficial facilitation elsewhere, especially 2:185.
topics.reason: The contrast with 2:185 prevents making ease itself negative; the local named institution is the harmful reversal.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining the second purpose verb to the first complement frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the next verb as a second objective under the same carried complement. The ayah therefore does not stop with social fracture; it coordinates that fracture with devotional obstruction as one restricted strategy.

topics.headline: conjunction joins a second purpose verb under the same complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that social damage and devotional obstruction are coordinated objectives of one restricted strategy.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the blocking verb to the earlier complement frame instead of starting a disconnected clause.

words.gloss_range: active blocking of the addressees away from devotional access
words.root_gloss_range: blocking, repelling, turning away, and obstruction; locally a transitive verb with separation complement is active
words.prose: {{ar:يَصُدَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:yaṣuddakum}}) begins the second purpose: the adversary wants to block the addressees themselves. The attached plural object makes them the direct target, and the following separation frame names what they are being turned away from. The root image is path-obstruction, so the strategy moves from poisoning the space among people to cutting them off from devotional access. The same satanic blocking pattern appears elsewhere (27:24; 29:38), while here it is mediated through intoxication and gambling.

topics.headline: second purpose verb remains under the intent frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blocking remembrance and prayer is not a side effect but the second stated objective.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated under the earlier complement marker and redirects the strategy from social space to devotional access.

topics.headline: the addressees are directly blocked from a path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees as direct objects being turned away from what should remain accessible.
topics.reason: The verb takes the attached object and the following separation complement, matching the path-blocking root image.

topics.headline: obstruction answers the prior avoid-command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to avoid the impure work is answered by the adversary trying to block them from the opposite path.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows link the obstruction field to satanic action and to the prior avoidance frame.

words.gloss_range: first separation preposition introducing what the blocking removes them from
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) gives the blocking verb its first separation target. The obstruction is not vague; it is distance from the remembrance phrase that follows. Because a second separation preposition will be repeated later, this first one begins a balanced deprivation pattern rather than a single merged object.

topics.headline: first separation frame names loss of remembrance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the obstruction is defined by distance from a specific devotional target, not by blockage in the abstract.
topics.reason: The preposition marks the first object from which the addressees are blocked and starts a repeated separation pattern.

words.gloss_range: construct verbal noun naming remembrance of the divine name
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, mindfulness, and invocation; locally a substantive devotional target in construct is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ذِكْرِ}} ({{tr:dhikri}}) is a genitive verbal noun under the separation preposition and in construct with the divine name. That makes remembrance a substantive target of obstruction, not a passing activity. The root range includes remembering, mentioning, and mindfulness; locally it is narrowed to devotional remembrance, sharpened by the forgetting contrast in 5:14. It also forms the first half of the blocked remembrance-prayer pair.

topics.headline: construct verbal noun names remembrance of the divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remembrance as a substantive devotional target bound directly to the divine name.
topics.reason: The verbal noun is governed by the separation preposition and enters construct with the following proper name.

topics.headline: remembrance field opposes forgetting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blocked target is not bare mention only, but mindful remembrance opposed to the forgetting chain seen in 5:14.
topics.reason: The broader remembrance-mention-mindfulness range is narrowed by construct grammar and devotional context, while the 5:14 forgetting echo sharpens its force.

topics.headline: remembrance pairs with prayer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remembrance as the first half of a devotional pair, completed by the established prayer.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows identify the remembrance-prayer pairing and its place as the first blocked target.

words.gloss_range: the divine proper name as the genitive anchor of remembrance
words.root_gloss_range: worship, seeking refuge, and divine reference; locally the fixed proper name completes the construct phrase
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) completes the construct phrase, so the blocked remembrance is remembrance of the divine name, not generic recollection. The fixed proper name anchors the first devotional target and closes that phrase. Its derivational pressure keeps worship, refuge, and devoted turning present, while local syntax keeps the selected role as construct anchor. It also recalls the opposed will-pattern in Surah 5: the will associated with law and purification in 5:1 and 5:6 stands over against the adversary's will to obstruct remembrance here.

topics.headline: proper name completes the remembrance construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blocked remembrance is relationally anchored to the divine name, not a generic act of recollection.
topics.reason: The proper noun is the genitive second term of the construct and closes the first blocked target phrase.

topics.headline: the divine name recalls opposed will-patterns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one whose remembrance is blocked is also the one whose will frames law and purification in 5:1 and 5:6.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows cite 5:1 and 5:6, making the divine name part of the ayah's opposed-will network.

topics.headline: fixed divine name concentrates worship and refuge associations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the density of the proper name, while local syntax keeps the selected role as construct anchor.
topics.reason: Disputed derivational associations are retained as theological pressure but narrowed by the fixed proper-name function here.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining two separated devotional targets
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins a second devotional target to the first. Because the next word repeats the separation preposition, the coordination does not flatten remembrance and prayer into one phrase; it binds them as a pair while preserving separate weight for each.

topics.headline: coordination introduces a second separated target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that awareness and ritual are joined as one devotional field while still receiving separate prepositional weight.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second separation phrase and prepares the repeated preposition.

words.gloss_range: repeated separation preposition independently governing the prayer phrase
words.prose: {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) repeats the separation frame before the prayer noun. That repetition gives the second target independent force: the adversary blocks from remembrance of the divine name and from the established prayer, not from one loosely merged devotional phrase.

topics.headline: repeated preposition gives prayer independent weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prayer is not merely appended to remembrance; it receives its own separation frame.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition independently governs the prayer noun and creates two equal deprivation phrases.

words.gloss_range: the established prayer as structured devotional connection
words.root_gloss_range: prayer, supplication, connection, close following, with a derivational dispute retained as coloring; locally established prayer is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣalāwati}}) names the second blocked target as the established prayer. Its root and form make it more than an undefined rite: it is structured connection and maintained practice. Placed after remembrance, it completes the devotional pair as the formal counterpart to continuous awareness. The 29:45 echo adds a sharp irony: the practice described there as restraining wrongdoing is precisely what the adversary seeks to block here.

topics.headline: definite prayer as established structured connection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer as the established structured practice of connection, not an undefined act of devotion.
topics.reason: Definiteness, gerund form, and root evidence support established prayer as structured connection.

topics.headline: prayer completes and climaxes the remembrance pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer as the formal counterpart that closes the list of blocked devotional targets.
topics.reason: Rows identify remembrance as continuous awareness and prayer as structured practice, with prayer placed last before the question.

topics.headline: blocked prayer is also a restraining force in 29:45
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the practice blocked here is described elsewhere as restraining wrongdoing (29:45).
topics.reason: The 29:45 echo is valid as contrast and payoff, while local syntax still selects the prayer target rather than importing the full scene.

words.gloss_range: resultative particle pivoting from diagnosis into demanded response
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from diagnosis to demand. Given the restricted strategy just disclosed, the closing question follows as consequence. The particle therefore converts the warning into address-pressure: the audience must now answer the strategy by stopping.

topics.headline: consequence launches the demanded response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from disclosed strategy into required response.
topics.reason: The resultative particle makes the closing question follow as consequence, not as a new unrelated topic.

words.gloss_range: yes-no interrogative carrying rhetorical command force
words.prose: {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) keeps the close formally interrogative while the discourse makes it a demand. The question is stronger than a bare imperative because it asks the addressees to answer with their state, not merely to hear an order. The final architecture is therefore a state-assessment: are they now people who desist?

topics.headline: question form carries command force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah demands cessation through a question that forces self-declaration.
topics.reason: The particle remains a yes-no interrogative while the discourse gives it imperative force.

topics.headline: closing clause assesses state rather than narrating action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from command register into identity-question register.
topics.reason: Rows identify the final clause as interrogative and nominal, oriented to agency and state.

words.gloss_range: explicit second-person plural subject before the participial predicate
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}) makes the addressees overt before the final predicate. The pronoun is not needed for basic person marking, so its retention is rhetorical: you, specifically, must answer. It also completes the earlier address-chain, where the audience was first the between-space, then the object being blocked, and now the subject asked to declare a state.

topics.headline: overt pronoun makes the audience answer-bearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audience isolated as the ones who must answer, even though the predicate already carries person and number.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is syntactically explicit and rhetorically retained before the participial predicate.

topics.headline: the earlier you-suffix becomes explicit subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees moving from harmed relational space to directly blocked object to explicit responsible subject.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows connect the suffix chain to the final independent pronoun.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII active participle naming the addressees as desisting people
words.root_gloss_range: forbidding, stopping, reaching a limit, and rational restraint; locally inhabited cessation is selected
words.prose: {{ar:مُّنتَهُونَ}} ({{tr:muntahūna}}) is the final predicate and the landing point of the ayah. As an active participle in a nominal question, it asks whether the addressees are people characterized by desisting, not merely whether they will stop once. The root range adds cessation at a limit and intelligent restraint, which answers the earlier mind-covering mechanism. The final plural ending also ties the demanded state to the success horizon of 5:90, while the 2:275 echo shows the same cessation root used for stopping exploitative systems.

topics.headline: active participle demands inhabited cessation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question asks whether they are characterized by desisting, not merely whether they will perform a one-time stop.
topics.reason: The active participle functions as the nominal predicate and names a state borne by the addressed group.

topics.headline: desisting carries limit and rational restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices cessation as intelligent restraint at the limit, especially against the mind-covering mechanism already named.
topics.reason: The broader root range of forbidding, stopping, limit, and intellect is narrowed to the Form VIII participial state but remains semantically active.

topics.headline: final word closes the ayah on communal cessation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument landing on communal desisting, with echoes to cessation in 2:275 and success language in 5:90.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يريد، يوقع بينكم، العداوة والبغضاء، في الخمر والميسر
baseline_models.mechanism: A will-contesting agent uses cognitive cover and chance-based division to make transgression and aversion settle inside an existing social bond. The harm is therefore relational engineering, not merely two private vices followed by bad feelings.

activation_trace.role: Marauding contests another person's will, supplying the persuasive drive that recruits participants into the mechanism.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the installation of hostility as a settled social fact.
The connection standing between parties supplies the bond in which the hostile wedge is planted.
Crossing a limit unjustly supplies the outward conduct by which latent hostility breaches mutual rights.
The soul's aversion supplies the inward recoil that makes the social breach self-reinforcing.
Covering supplies impaired visibility of consequences and obligations within the shared encounter.
Lots that divide a carcass supply a concrete zero-sum allocation mechanism that creates winners, losers, and contested shares.

changed_reading.before: Intoxicants and gambling produce interpersonal bad feeling.
changed_reading.after: They form an engineered wedge: obscured judgment and unaccountable division convert an existing bond into transgression outside and aversion inside.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الخمر والميسر، يصدكم عن ذكر الله وعن الصلاة
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering of awareness and the lure of easy opening create a competing attention circuit. That circuit increases distance, turns the person away from inward recollection, and displaces embodied, scheduled worship.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance supply the widening separation from the practices that keep attention oriented.
Covering supplies the cognitive occlusion through which recollection loses salience.
An opening that feels easy after difficulty supplies the reward expectation that repeatedly recaptures attention.
Turning away and diverting supplies the active rerouting of attention rather than a merely accidental lapse.
Bringing something present after forgetfulness supplies the inward faculty that the capture circuit suppresses.
The specified embodied worship supplies the recurrent public and bodily practice displaced by the competing circuit.

changed_reading.before: The practices distract people from remembering and praying.
changed_reading.after: They capture and reroute attention through complementary mechanisms: one covers awareness, the other promises easy reward, and together they displace both inward recall and embodied worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إنما يريد الشيطان ... فهل أنتم منتهون
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah begins with an adversarial will trying to bend other wills but ends by directly returning the decision to the addressees. Desistance is both a restraining act and an endpoint imposed by reason, so the question exposes a point at which the induced circuit can be terminated.

activation_trace.role: Contesting another's will supplies the pressure exerted at the opening of the causal chain.
Restraint and cessation supply the audience's active brake on the induced behavior.
A reached limit supplies the definite endpoint at which repetition no longer continues.
Reason that restrains from ugliness supplies the faculty by which the addressees can recognize and stop the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The final question intensifies a prohibition.
changed_reading.after: It marks an agency handoff: after exposing how another will recruits and redirects them, the ayah asks the addressees to impose a reasoned endpoint themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence first rejects self-made prohibition of good things, releases what is lawful, and forbids overstepping; it then marks the listed practices as contaminating and commands distance. The focus demand to desist is therefore a discriminating boundary around mechanisms of harm, not a generalized rejection of pleasure or consumption.

activation_trace.role: Prohibition as prevention supplies the rejected act of inventing a blanket ban on good things.
The good as contrary to the corrupt supplies the positive category that remains available.
Release from a restriction supplies the permission against which the later precise avoidance is measured.
Unjust crossing of a limit supplies the governing boundary violation that the focus ayah later makes socially concrete.
A contaminant that smears and mixes supplies the diagnosis distinguishing these practices from lawful good enjoyment.
Putting something to the side and keeping distance supplies the precise protective response to the diagnosed mechanism.

structural_cues: 5:87-88 opens lawful good consumption while forbidding transgression; 5:90 then isolates the four contaminating practices for avoidance.
The focus ayah justifies its closing demand by naming relational and ritual effects rather than by condemning consumption as such.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered permission, limit, contamination, and avoidance sequence; I infer that this sequence scopes the focus cessation as bounded discrimination. A live alternative is that the commands are adjacent legal topics without a shared boundary logic.

changed_reading.before: Are you stopping can sound like a demand for broad ascetic withdrawal.
changed_reading.after: It demands precise withdrawal from practices whose operative effects cross relational and ritual limits while preserving the lawful-good field around them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope surrounds maysir's division by lots with two accountable allocation systems: repair for bound oaths through concrete redistribution, and assessed compensation for a taking through equivalence and balance. Gambling now reads as an anti-legal allocation regime whose arbitrary gains generate the enmity that measured repair is designed to prevent.

activation_trace.role: Division of a carcass by lots supplies the focus practice's chance-based distribution mechanism.
Binding and ratifying a commitment supplies the accountable obligation that loose chance allocation lacks.
Covering and effacing an offense supplies a reparative purpose for the prescribed transfer.
Feeding another supplies a concrete outward redistribution that repairs rather than polarizes.
Answering an act with its due recompense supplies causal accountability for a loss.
Equivalence and a matching counterpart supply the metric by which compensation is constrained.
Balancing between two matters supplies adjudicated proportionality in place of a lucky draw.

structural_cues: 5:89 lists food, clothing, freeing, or fasting as controlled repair for a bound oath.
5:95 places an intentional taking under equivalent compensation assessed by two just persons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maysir's lot-division branch and nearby systems of bound, measured repair; I infer a contrast between arbitrary and accountable allocation. A live alternative is that the oath and hunting rules are independent cases rather than a foil for maysir.

changed_reading.before: Maysir is a risky pastime that provokes quarrels.
changed_reading.after: Maysir is an unaccountable distribution apparatus: it assigns gains and losses by chance where the surrounding pericope repeatedly requires obligation, equivalence, repair, and balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later witness procedure explicitly uses prayer as the temporal threshold after which disputed testimony is detained, sworn, tested for concealment, and if necessary countered. Being blocked from prayer can therefore remove not only worship but a shared procedural checkpoint that disciplines memory and repairs the very enmity named in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Specified embodied worship supplies the focus practice whose social-procedural reach is newly exposed.
The same specified worship supplies the common time marker after which witnesses enter a solemn procedure.
Presence with observation supplies the evidentiary role whose reliability the procedure protects.
An oath apportioned to its bearers supplies the solemn accountability imposed on competing testimony.
Hiding and concealing supplies the evidentiary failure the post-prayer oath is designed to block.
Discovery of what was hidden supplies the trigger for reopening and correcting the first testimony.
Establishing and manifesting a right supplies the corrective aim of the counter-testimony.
Rejecting what is false or defective supplies the threatened reversal that deters corrupt oaths.

structural_cues: 5:106 says to detain the two witnesses after prayer; the branchless detention construction makes prayer a procedural threshold.
5:106-108 moves from paired witnesses to oaths, discovery, counter-witnesses, and the possibility that prior oaths will be returned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit post-prayer testimony procedure; I infer that shared prayer can synchronize and solemnize communal dispute repair, so diversion from it leaves enmity less governable. A live alternative is that prayer functions only as a convenient time marker, not as civic infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: Blocking prayer adds ritual neglect to the social damage.
changed_reading.after: Blocking prayer may also disable a shared checkpoint for truthful testimony and dispute correction, allowing concealed wrongs and enmity to persist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair joins covering with the promise of ease; 5:100 then denies that abundant, eye-pleasing impurity equals the good and addresses people capable of core discernment. The practices thus function as a counterfeit valuation system: salience and quantity conceal quality while the discriminating center is covered.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the obscuration under which apparent value can displace assessed value.
Apparent ease after difficulty supplies the shortcut appeal by which the inferior option captures choice.
Slag expelled from worked metal supplies impurity that can be plentiful yet remains waste.
The good as the contrary of the corrupt supplies the non-quantitative standard of comparison.
Beauty in the eye supplies the seductive appearance that can override qualitative judgment.
Growth in number supplies abundance as the misleading metric explicitly denied equivalence.
Success and continued survival supply the alternative outcome promised to disciplined discernment.

structural_cues: 5:100 places non-equivalence, visual appeal, abundance, God-consciousness, and success in one contrast.
The address to أولي الألباب is branchless but structurally names the discerning core that covering and distraction compromise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus mechanisms of covering and ease plus 5:100's quality-versus-salience contrast; I infer that the verse diagnoses distorted valuation. A live alternative is that 5:100 states a general maxim without specifically explaining the preceding practices.

changed_reading.before: The practices are attractive despite being bad.
changed_reading.after: They manufacture bad judgment: covered discernment, easy payoff, visual appeal, and abundance combine to make inferior value appear competitive with the good.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 5:113 the same desire root opens a second consumption sequence: wanting to eat leads toward settled hearts, knowledge, verified truth, and witness. Read against the focus sequence of satanic wanting, consumption, hostility, and blocked remembrance, desire itself is not the fixed evil; it is a contested channel whose object and endpoint determine whether appetite destabilizes or settles.

activation_trace.role: Contesting another's will supplies the adversarial direction imposed on appetite in the focus sequence.
Will and intention supply the repeated opening verb for a contrasting humanly voiced desire sequence.
Taking food supplies consumption as a shared node between desire and its later consequences.
Stillness and reassurance supply the opposite affective endpoint to hostility and aversion.
The heart supplies the inner site in which the alternative sequence settles rather than agitates.
Disclosure to the knower supplies an epistemic outcome opposed to cognitive covering.
Fulfillment of a promise in deed supplies verification rather than chance-based expectation.
Presence with observation supplies public witness as the outward completion of settled knowledge.

structural_cues: 5:91 and 5:113 both place a form of يريد immediately before a consumption-related causal sequence.
The first sequence ends in hostility and blocked remembrance; the second explicitly names reassurance, knowledge, truth, and witness, though 5:115 keeps the second sequence morally risky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated desire root and the two different result chains; I infer a contrast in how appetite is directed and terminated. A live alternative is that the two uses of desire are local descriptions without deliberate mirroring.

changed_reading.before: Satan has a hostile will, while the audience is asked only to resist it.
changed_reading.after: The pericope stages desire as a contested causal channel: appetite can be recruited into destabilizing capture or directed toward reassurance, knowledge, and witness, and the closing question returns that direction to the audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command in 5:110 to remember a favor opens a long evidentiary recital, yet its clear signs are finally redescribed as magic by those who cover truth. Remembrance in the focus therefore protects not only devotional attention but the classification chain by which gifts and signs remain recognizable as evidence.

activation_trace.role: Making what was absent present to the mind supplies the focus faculty whose evidentiary function is activated.
A reminder that restores presence supplies the opening operation for reconstructing the chain of favors and signs.
A beneficent state and gift supply the remembered material whose source and meaning must be preserved.
Appearance and disclosure supply both the manifest signs and the text's insistence that their status is clear.
Covering truth supplies the interpretive refusal that breaks the link between manifested sign and acknowledgment.
Diversion and deception supply the false category into which clear evidence is reclassified.

structural_cues: 5:110 begins with remember My favor, enumerates signs repeatedly marked by permission, and ends with opponents calling the clear display magic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a remembrance command followed by evidence and its hostile reclassification; I infer that remembered provenance stabilizes truthful recognition, so blocking dhikr enables misclassification. A live alternative is that the remembrance is solely gratitude and the magic accusation a separate polemical response.

changed_reading.before: Being blocked from God's remembrance means devotional forgetfulness.
changed_reading.after: It also means losing the memory structure that preserves provenance and lets evidence remain evidence; once that structure is covered, a clear sign can be recoded as deception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pericope places benefit with truth, joins it to durable remaining, and names that outcome success. This supplies a rival scale of gain against maysir's easy or wealthy appearance: chance compresses gain into immediate acquisition, while truthful reliability produces benefit that does not consume the social bond.

activation_trace.role: Breadth and wealth supply the apparent gain by which maysir advertises itself.
Benefit as the contrary of harm supplies the final criterion for judging whether a gain is real.
Complete soundness and stability supply truth as the condition of durable benefit.
Stable remaining not quickly lost supplies duration as a test that immediate chance-gain fails.
Attaining good and escaping loss supplies the pericope's explicit name for genuine success.

structural_cues: 5:119 syntactically binds benefit to the truthful and then calls the durable outcome the great success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maysir's wealth image and the closing chain truth-benefit-duration-success; I infer that the chain exposes chance-gain as counterfeit success. A live alternative is that the final reward scale is not intended as a direct contrast with maysir.

changed_reading.before: Maysir is wrong despite offering possible gain.
changed_reading.after: Maysir counterfeits gain itself: it offers immediate wealth while consuming truth and trust, whereas the pericope defines benefit by truthful durability and escape from loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a dough process and a non-dominant split-root branch of ع د و onto social affect. It remains anchored because every element comes from a focus word and jointly explains delayed recurrence; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical meaning or an etymological claim.

activation_trace.role: Fermentation of dough supplies a hidden process in which an initially covered mixture changes over time.
Back-and-forth unsettled movement supplies repeated return to the provoking circuit.
Falling and fixing supplies the moment when latent resentment becomes an established incident.
Habit and practiced recurrence supply the non-dominant image of hostility becoming a learned social routine.

changed_reading.before: Hostility erupts directly during intoxication or gambling.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, covered grievances may ferment through repeated returns until an incident fixes them as a habitual pattern of hostility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain hydraulic overlay, surprising because it connects rare water-route branches of the focus words with the closing river scene. It remains valid as an anchored spatial mechanism for obstruction, settling, and reopened flow; downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy and never claim that صد or انتهى literally denotes this whole hydraulic reading here.

activation_trace.role: A route leading to water supplies the path from which attention is diverted.
A mountain barrier supplies the obstruction that interrupts movement along that path.
A pool where floodwater reaches its end and settles supplies desistance as arrested destructive momentum.
Continuous flowing supplies the life-giving movement available after obstruction is no longer governing the course.
Opening and widening until flow is released supplies the contrasting image of an unblocked channel.

changed_reading.before: Diversion and desistance describe a behavioral stop.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, destructive appetite dams the route of attention; desistance lets its momentum settle so a sustaining current can be reopened rather than repeatedly forced into blockage.

strongest_changes: Maysir became an unaccountable allocation regime contrasted with the pericope's repeated systems of obligation, equivalence, and repair.
Prayer became a shared procedural checkpoint for testimony and dispute correction, linking ritual obstruction directly back to persistent enmity.
The repeated desire-consumption sequence in 5:113 reframed the final question as recovery and redirection of contested agency.
Remembrance became evidence-preserving memory whose loss permits clear signs to be reclassified as deception.
summary.what_was_special: The four-pericope context turned the focus ayah into one coupled system: distorted valuation and appetite fracture social bonds, capture attention, and disable the ritual, legal, and mnemonic practices that could expose and repair the fracture.
remaining_uncertainties: The post-prayer witness procedure clearly uses prayer as a threshold, but whether that makes prayer civic infrastructure rather than only a solemn time marker remains inferential.
The two desire sequences are strongly parallel at root and causal-chain level, but their deliberate contrast cannot be proved from recurrence alone.
The fermentation and hydraulic readings are useful branch-anchored analogies, not primary lexical readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The practices make hostility land and become fixed.** `و ق ع B001` is falling into occurrence, `ع د و B003` enmity, and `ب غ ض B001` aversion. The packet supplies intoxicant/gambling as the medium; I infer that they convert latent rivalry into settled social reality.
2. **Diversion blocks both memory and embodied orientation.** `ص د د B001` is turning aside, `ذ ك ر B003` bringing to mind, and `ن ه ي B002` endpoint. I infer that the closing question asks whether the causal chain has finally reached the point where pursuit stops.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The substances are delivery channels for social collision and attentional blockage.** Fixed **و ق ع / B001** (“thing falling into occurrence and fixed reality”) gives *yūqiʿa* the role of making enmity land between people, while fixed **ص د د / B001** (“turning away and turning aside”) diverts them from remembrance and prayer. The prior ayah named taint; 5:92 follows with obedience and warning, and 5:93 repeats guarding after consumed things. I infer two coordinated outputs from one mechanism: hostility occupies the interpersonal interval while ritual attention is rerouted. The question “will you stop?” asks whether users will terminate this causal system, not merely concede a classification.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:92 separated completed delivery from receiver choice, and 5:93 answered the call to stop with repeated layers of guarding rather than a one-time verbal concession.

يدخل فيه المعاد بمعنى المصير والمرجع، والزمان أو المكان الذي يعود إليه، ومعاد الحاج، ومعاد مكة أو الآخرة والجنة في نقل المصادر.
يدخل فيه قولهم ما يبدئ وما يعيد أو لا يبدي ولا يعيد بمعنى لا يتكلم ببادئة ولا عائدة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekrarlanan eylemin kolaylaşarak yerleşmesini temel alır; alışma, alıştırma, sürekli uygulama, deneyimden doğan yeterlik ve çiftleşmeye alıştırılmış erkek hayvan bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın alışkanlık alanını, türemiş alışma ve alıştırma biçimlerini ve yalnız verilen hayvan tamlamasına bağlı özel kullanımı ayrı tutar.

facets.statement: Tekrarlanan eylemin kolaylaşıp yerleşik davranış veya yaradılış niteliği kazanması çekirdektir.
Bir şeye alışmak, bir canlıyı alıştırmak ve sürekli uygulama yoluyla yeterlik kazanmak bu çekirdeğin süreç uzantılarıdır.
Bir işi defalarca deneyen kişi ile çiftleşmeye defalarca katılmış erkek hayvan, edinilmiş deneyimin özel nitelemeleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عيادة المريض، وعواد المريض، والمعادة في المصيبة أو المأتم التي يغشاها الناس، وما يرجع فيه الزائر مرة بعد مرة.
يدخل فيه العائدة، والمعروف والصلة والفضل، وما عاد على الإنسان بنفع أو رفق أو عطف، وقولهم هذا أعود عليك.
يدخل فيه العيد، والأعياد، وكل يوم مجمع أو يوم سرور، وما يعاود الإنسان من هم أو حب أو حال، وشهود العيد.
يدخل فيه العود من الإبل، والبعير أو الجمل المسن، والناقة أو الشاة أو الفرس في نقل بعض العرب، وما بلغ وقت السن بعد البزول، والاستعارة في الاستعانة بأهل السن والمعرفة.
يدخل فيه الطريق القديم أو العادي، والسؤدد العود، والرحم العود أو العودة بمعنى القديمة، وكل قدم صرحت به المصادر في هذا اللفظ.
يدخل فيه العود من الخشب، وكل خشبة أو خشبة دقيقة في نقل مقاييس، وعود التبخر، والعود الذي يضرب به أو المزهر المعروف.
يدخل فيه العود في الظهار، سواء فسر بتكرار القول، أو الجماع بعد الظهار، أو إمساك المرأة، أو فعل ما حلف ألا يفعله بحسب الأقوال المنقولة.
يدخل فيه عاد القبيلة، والنسبة عادي بمعنى قديم منسوب إلى عاد، واسم عادياء، والإبل العيدية المنسوبة إلى فحل أو إلى عاد بحسب النقل.

concept_gloss.text: Bir yerden, nesneden ya da işten ayrıldıktan sonra ona geri yönelmek veya başlanmış bir şeyi bir kez daha yapmak; türemiş biçimlerde bir başkasına yeniden yaptırmak ya da tekrar istemektir.
Bir varlığın sonunda döneceği yer veya ulaşacağı son durak; bağlama göre dönüşün gerçekleştiği zaman ya da mekândır.
Bir eylemi tekrar tekrar yaparak onu kolay, yerleşik bir davranış veya yatkınlık hâline getirmek; bu yolla süreklilik, deneyim ve yapabilme gücü kazanmaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın merkezini sevginin karşıtı olan ve kişinin istemediği şeyden içten uzaklaşmasıyla beliren sevmeme durumu olarak kurar. Geçişli, karşılıklı ve sonuç bildiren türevler bu merkezin katılımcı ve süreç uzantılarıdır; merkezin yerine geçirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın sevmeme çekirdeğini, birini sevmemeyi, karşılıklı sevmemeyi, sevilmez duruma gelmeyi ve başkasına sevilmez göstermeyi birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Birini ya da bir şeyi sevginin karşıtı bir tutumla istememek ve ondan içten uzak durmaktır. Bu çekirdek, bir başkasını sevmeme, karşılıklı sevmeme, birinin sevilmez duruma gelmesi ya da başkalarına sevilmez gösterilmesi biçimlerinde gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Temel durum, sevginin karşıtı olan sevmeme ve istenmeyen şeyden içten uzak durmadır.
Bu tutum daha yoğun olduğunda güçlü ve yerleşik bir sevmeme derecesine ulaşır.
Tutum bir kişiye yöneltilebilir veya iki tarafın birbirini sevmemesi biçiminde karşılıklı kurulabilir.
Bir kişi ya da şey sevilmez duruma gelebilir veya bir başkasının gözünde sevilmez duruma getirilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sevmemeyi sevginin karşıtı olan bir tutum olarak ortaklaştırır. Toplu kanıtın kaynaklara göre ayrışan anlatımında bu tutum bir yerde kişinin istemediği şeyden içten uzak durmasıyla tanımlanır; başka yerlerde yoğunluk bildiren biçimler ve karşılıklı kullanım ayrıca belirtilir.

error_profile.loses: Kolaylık, hazır duruma gelme ve kolaylaştırma işlemlerinin tümünü yitirir.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün miktar azlığını bildiren ayrı dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hazır duruma gelme, hazırlama ve kişiler arası kolaylık gösterme kapsamları bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işin kişiye hafif gelmesi ve yükünün azalması daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işte güçlük bulunmamasını ve işin rahatça yapılabilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kolaylık durumundan oluş ve oldurma süreçlerine uzanır; komşu dal ise işin hafif ve kişiye güç gelmeyen niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalın kolaylık ve bir şeyin kendiliğinden hazır duruma gelmesi de kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işin önünü açma ve yapılmasını sağlayacak yolu belirginleştirme öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir işteki engeli azaltma ve onun yapılmasını kolaylaştırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal durum, oluş ve oldurma anlamlarını birlikte taşır; komşu dal özellikle bir işin yolunu açan etkin kolaylaştırmayı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu adayları karşılaştırıldı; en yakın sınır karışıklığını kolay ve hafif olma ile işi etkin biçimde kolaylaştırma dalları oluşturduğu için yalnızca bunlar yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسر ضد العسر، والميسور ضد المعسور، وتيسر الشيء واستيسر إذا تسهل وتهيأ، وتيسير الشيء وتهيئته، والمساهلة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: اليسر: ضد العسر (maqayis;mufradat)؛ الميسور: ضد المعسور، وتيسر واستيسر بمعنى تهيأ (sihah)؛ تيسر واستيسر أي تسهل وتهيأ، وأيسرت المرأة وتيسرت في كذا أي سهلته وهيأته (mufradat)؛ ياسره أي ساهله (sihah)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسير بمعنى القليل، والمدة أو الشيء اليسير من جهة قلته.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi maddi genişlik ve varlıklılığı, ayrıca bir kimsenin varlıklı duruma gelmesini açıkça bildirir. Dal çerçevesi durum ile bu duruma geçişi birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte taşıyabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, varlıklı olma durumunu bu duruma geçmeyi bildiren türemiş kullanımdan ayırır ve ikisini maddi olanakla sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Maddi olanakların bol olması ve kişinin varlıklı bulunmasıdır. Türemiş kullanım, kişinin sonradan bu duruma erişmesini bildirir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, maddi olanak bolluğu ve varlıklı olma durumudur.
Bir kişinin varlıklı duruma gelmesi, durum çekirdeğinin oluş bildiren uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar maddi genişlik ile varlıklılık anlamlarında birleşir; bir kişinin varlıklı duruma gelmesini bildiren eylem de bu durumun oluş uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin veya durumun yeterli ve bol maddi olanağa sahip oluşunu anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Maddi genişlik, bolluk ve varlıklı olma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin önceki durumundan çıkarak yeterli veya bol maddi olanağa eriştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Varlıklılığa geçiş sürecini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Süregelen maddi bolluk durumunu ad olarak karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Varlıklı duruma gelmeyi bildiren belirli oluş kullanımı bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Maddi gücün yanında yapabilme gücü ve genel yeterlilik kapsamı da vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin maddi bakımdan geniş olanaklara sahip olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal maddi varlıklılık durumuna ve ona erişmeye odaklanır; komşu dal maddi alanın ötesinde yapabilme gücü ve yeterliliğe de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Varlıklılığın süregelen durumunu ve maddi genişliği de adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önceden yoksul olma koşulunu özellikle gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin varlıklı duruma geçmesini bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geçiş için önceki bir yoksulluk koşulu koymaz; komşu dalın ayırt edici sınırı varlığın yoksulluktan sonra kazanılmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; genel varlıklılık ile yoksulluktan sonra varlıklı olma dalları, durum ve geçiş sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الميسرة واليسار واليسارة بمعنى السعة والغنى، وأيسر الرجل إذا استغنى.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الميسرة والميسرة: السعة والغنى؛ واليسار واليسارة: الغنى، وقد أيسر الرجل أي استغنى (sihah)؛ الميسرة واليسار عبارة عن الغنى (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسار لليد أو خلاف اليمين، والأيسر خلاف الأيمن، والميسرة خلاف الميمنة، والتياسر أو المياسرة بمعنى الأخذ ذات اليسار، ومن يعمل بكلتا يديه.
يدخل فيه وصف الإنسان أو الفرس باللين وسرعة المتابعة، والقوائم الخفاف، وحسن نقل القوائم في الدابة.
يدخل فيه قولهم يسرت الغنم إذا كثر لبنها ونسلها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi fal oklarıyla oynanan geleneksel talih oyununu, bu oyuna katılanları ve kesilen devenin parçalarını oklarla paylaştırma işlemini birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi oyun, katılımcı ve paylaştırma aşamalarını koruyarak kaynağı doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, oyunun adını katılımcı adlarından ve devenin kesilip parçalarının oklarla paylaştırılmasını bildiren eylem biçimlerinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Fal oklarıyla oynanan geleneksel bir talih oyunu ve bu oyunun çevresindeki paylaştırma düzenidir. Katılımcılar bir deveyi keser, parçalarını okların belirlediği paylara göre bölüşür.

facets.statement: Temel kurum, fal oklarıyla oynanan geleneksel talih oyunudur.
Oyunu oynayan kişi ve oyuna katılmak üzere toplanan topluluk ayrı adlandırmalara konu olur.
Katılımcıların deveyi kesip parçalarını oklarla belirlenen paylara göre bölüşmesi düzenin kurucu işlemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar fal oklarına dayalı talih oyunu, oyuna katılan kişiler ve kesilen devenin parçalarını oklarla belirlenen paylara göre bölüşme işlemlerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: fal oklarıyla oynanan paylaştırmalı talih oyunu
concept_gloss.applicability: Oyunu, katılımcıları ve kesilen devenin oklarla belirlenen paylara bölünmesini birlikte temsil eden tarihsel açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Fal oklarını, talih oyununu ve paylaştırma düzenini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Katılımcıların oyun için bir deveyi kesmesi ve et parçalarını çekilen oklara göre bölüşmesi bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme ve oklarla belirlenen paylara göre bölüşme işlemlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Oyunun genel adını ve oyuncu adlarını kapsamaz.

error_profile.adds: Fal okları veya deve paylaştırması içermeyen bütün para ve şans oyunlarını kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Tarihsel araç ve paylaştırma düzenini belirtmeyen genel oyun adıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Oyunun bütünü, oyuncu topluluğu ve devenin oklarla paylaştırılması kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir oyuncu veya oyunda kullanılan belirli bir ok adı öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aynı tarihsel talih oyununun katılımcı ve araç çevresinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal oyun düzenini ve paylaştırma işlemini bütünüyle anlatır; komşu dal yalnızca bir oyuncu türünü veya belirli bir oyun okunu adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Payın fal oklarıyla oynanan oyunda ve kesilen deve üzerinden belirlenmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir bağlamdaki belirli pay veya hak genel olarak kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir bütünden kişiye ayrılan pay düşüncesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal payı belirli bir oyun, kesim ve ok çekme düzenine bağlar; komşu dal payı bu tarihsel koşullar olmadan genel olarak adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün oyun aracı, oyuncu ve pay adayları incelendi; oyuncu veya ok adı ile genel pay kavramı, bütün oyun düzeninin sınırını en açık gösteren karşılaştırmalardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الميسر قمار العرب بالأزلام، والأيسار أو الياسرون اللاعبون بالقداح، ويسر القوم الجزور إذا اجتزروها واقتسموا أعضاءها بالسهام.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأيسار: القوم يجتمعون على الميسر، واحدهم يسر؛ والميسر: القمار (maqayis)؛ الميسر: قمار العرب بالأزلام؛ الياسر: اللاعب بالقداح؛ اليسر والياسر بمعنى والجمع أيسار؛ يسر القوم الجزور أي اجتزروها واقتسموا أعضاءها (sihah)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسرة لأسرار الكف إذا كانت غير ملزقة، واليسرة سمة في الفخذين.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسر في الفتل إلى أسفل، والطعن اليسر حذاء الوجه.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه يسر أو اليسر اسما لمكان، ويسار علما لشخص في شاهد شعري.
يدخل فيه اليسار بمعنى الفتى كما أفرده ابن فارس.

root_profile.summary: Kök, kolaylık ve hazır oluş çevresindeki merkezden azlık, maddi bolluk, sol yön, uyumlu hareket, hayvancılık, tarihsel talih oyunu, beden izleri ve teknik yönelimlere uzanan çok dallı bir anlam yapısı taşır. Yer ve kişi adları ile genç erkek anlamı daha bağımsız uçlarda yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kişinin bir şeyden yüz çevirip uzaklaşmasını hem de başka birini bir işten alıkoyup uzaklaştırmasını açıkça kapsar. Verilen çerçeve bu geçişsiz ve geçişli kullanımları doğru biçimde ayırmaktadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimdeki yüz çevirme ile birini belirli bir işten alıkoyan yapı-bağımlı kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin bir şeyden yüz çevirerek uzaklaşması ya da bir başkasını bir işten alıkoyup ondan uzaklaştırmasıdır.

facets.statement: Özne, yöneldiği şeyden yüz çevirir, uzaklaşır veya ona katılmaktan kaçınır.
Geçişli kullanımda özne, başka bir kişiyi belirli bir işten men eder ve yönünü o işten çevirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyden geri dönme veya yüz çevirme ile başkasını aynı şeyden çevirip engelleme arasındaki ettirgenlik ayrımıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem öznenin kendisinin uzaklaşmasını hem de başka birini bir işten uzaklaştırmasını birlikte karşılayan üst anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüz çevirme, uzaklaşma ve başkasını engelleyip yönünü değiştirme ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin kendi isteğiyle bir şeyden uzaklaşmasını anlatan geçişsiz bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öznenin bir şeyden geri dönmesi ve ona yönelmemesi anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birini belirli bir işten engelleyip uzaklaştırdığı geçişli bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başka birini bir işten men etme ve yönünü o işten çevirme anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin kendisinin yüz çevirmesi ve katılmaktan kaçınması da çekirdeğe dahildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi, düşmanı veya cezayı savıp uzaklaştırma eylemini nesne merkezli olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şeyi mevcut yönünden veya hedefinden uzaklaştırma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı yüz çevirme ve bir kişiyi işten alıkoyma üzerine kuruludur; komşu dal ise gelen şeyi savıp etkisini önlemeye yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyden yüz çevirme, uzaklaşma ve başkasını uzaklaştırma yönelimi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin karşısında bulunma, ona yönelme, yaklaşma veya onunla yüz yüze gelme yönelimi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da özne ile bir hedef arasındaki yönelme ilişkisini düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal hedefle ilişkiyi kesip ondan uzaklaştırırken komşu dal hedefe dönmeyi, karşısına çıkmayı veya yaklaşmayı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan bütün komşu kartları değerlendirildi; sınırı en açık biçimde savma alanı ve karşıt yönelme dalı belirginleştirdi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı doğrudan suya götüren yol olarak tanımlar. Dal çerçevesi bu hedef ilişkisini eksiksiz korur ve onu genel yol anlamına genişletmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal yalnızca suya ulaşmayı sağlayan yol olarak tanımlanır ve genel yol anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir su kaynağına ulaşan veya insanı doğrudan suya götüren yoldur.

facets.statement: Yolun ayırt edici varış noktası bir su kaynağıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak kanıtı, sözcüğü genel bir güzergah olarak değil doğrudan suya giden yol olarak sınırlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir güzergahın özellikle su kaynağına ulaştırma işleviyle adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yol olma özelliğini ve suya ulaşma hedefini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın bunun suyun aktığı kanal değil suya ulaşan kara yolu olduğunu açıkça gösterdiği durumlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suya erişim sağlayan yol işlevini korur.
error_profile.collision: Türkçede suyun aktığı kanal anlamıyla karışabilir; bağlam bu olasılığı dışlamalıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolun mutlaka suya ulaşması gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel yolun yanı sıra bir amaca ulaştıran araç, çare ve bağlantı anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da üzerinde ilerlenerek bir yere ulaşılabilen güzergahı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hedefi su olan dar bir yol türüdür; komşu dal hedef ve kullanım bakımından genel bir yol kavramıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yol dalı, su hedefinin kurduğu dar sınırı en açık biçimde gösterdi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü hem dağ hem de dağın geçişi kesen veya araya giren bölümü olarak verir. Çerçevedeki engel niteliği bağımsız bir genel engel değil, dağın görünüş veya işlev özelliğidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dağ anlamını ve dağın engel oluşturan bölümünü kapsar; genel engel yapıları eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir dağ ya da dağın görüşü, yolu veya geçişi keserek araya giren bölümüdür.

facets.statement: Sözcük doğrudan bir dağı adlandırabilir.
Dağın araya girip geçişi veya görüşü kesen bölümü özellikle öne çıkarılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt dağ anlamını verir ve bunun içinde dağın araya girerek engel oluşturan yönünü belirginleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dağın kendisinin veya bir bölümünün araya girip geçişi ya da görüşü kestiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağ olma ile araya girip engel oluşturma özelliklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir dağın geçişi veya görüşü kestiği işlevsel bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Engelin doğal bir dağ kütlesinden oluştuğunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Engeli oluşturan varlık bir dağ veya dağın bölümüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki şey arasına konan her türlü ayırıcı ve engelleyici bölmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da araya girerek iki taraf arasındaki geçişi kesme işlevi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı engeli dağla sınırlar; komşu dal ise engelin maddesini veya doğal biçimini sınırlamayan genel bir ayırma kavramıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar değerlendirildi; genel ayırıcı engel dalı, dağla sınırlı çekirdeği en iyi belirginleştirdi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir eylemi yasaklayıp engelleme ile kişinin yasaklanan şeyden geri durmasını ve insanların kötülükten birbirini alıkoymasını birlikte doğrular.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın yasaklama anlamını korur; vazgeçme, benliği tutma ve karşılıklı engelleme yalnızca kanıtlanan yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi bir eylemden yasaklayarak, engelleyerek veya uyararak alıkoymak; ilgili yapılarda yasaklanan eylemden geri durmak ya da insanların birbirini kötülükten alıkoymasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir eylemin yapılmasını yasaklama, engelleme veya caydırma yoluyla durdurma.
Yasaklanan veya istenmeyen eylemden geri durma ve kendini tutma.
Bir topluluğun kötülük karşısında üyelerini karşılıklı olarak engellemesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, buyruğun karşıtı olan yasaklamayı, bir şeyi yaptırmamak için engellemeyi ve bunun sonucunda geri durmayı aynı çekirdek çevresinde birleştirir; karşılıklı engelleme bu çekirdeğin topluluk içindeki kullanımını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: bir eylemi yasaklama, engelleme veya ondan geri durma
concept_gloss.applicability: Yasaklayan kişi, engellenen kişi ve karşılıklı engelleme yapılarını kapsayan genel kavram karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yasaklama, engelleme ve geri durma yönlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiyi belirli bir eylemden men ettiği etkin kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Etkin yasaklama ve engelleme hareketini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendiliğinden geri durmasını ve karşılıklı engellemeyi kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yasaklanan eylemden geri durmayı ve insanların birbirini karşılıklı olarak engellemesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Azarlama ve sertçe geri çevirme biçimini özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir davranışı önlemeye ve kişiyi o davranıştan döndürmeye yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği genel yasaklama ve geri durmadır; komşu dal ise engellemenin azarlama biçimini daha belirgin taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sesli bir çıkış gerektirmeyen yasaklama, kendini tutma ve karşılıklı engelleme kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sesle azarlama, kovma veya hayvanı ve başka varlıkları sesle yöneltme kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir hareketi durdurmak için caydırıcı müdahaleyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalda sesli azarlama kurucu bir özelliktir; odak dalda yasaklama ses biçimine bağlı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini eylemden alıkoyma hareketini ve o eylemden geri durmayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin yapılmasının hükmen veya dokunulmazlık bakımından yasak oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapılmaması gereken davranışlar alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yasaklama eylemidir; komşu dal ise eylemin yasak statüsünü ve izin verilmezliğini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; azarlama, sesle durdurma ve yasak statüsü en açıklayıcı sınırları verdi, diğerleri yalnızca uzak tema veya başka iç dallarla ilişki gösterdi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şeyin ulaştığı son sınırı temel alır; haberin veya okun hedefe ulaştırılması bu çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısı, burun bağının ucu ise somut ve dar bir uzmanlaşmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın son ve sınır anlamı ile yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen ulaştırma ve bağ ucu kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilerleyişinin veya uzanışının vardığı son nokta ya da sınırdır; ilgili yapılarda bir haberin veya okun hedefe ulaştırılmasını, özel bir kullanımda da devenin burun bağının ucunu bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin ulaştığı son nokta, uç veya sınır.
Haber veya ok gibi bir şeyi amaçlanan alıcıya ya da hedefe ulaştırma.
Devenin burnundaki bağın uç bölümü.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, varılan son sınırı ana anlam olarak verir; bildirme ve gönderme yapılarında bir şeyi son hedefine ulaştırma, ayrıca belirli bir hayvan bağının uç kısmı bu uzanıştan türeyen kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.text: son noktaya varma veya bir şeyi hedefine ulaştırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Son sınır çekirdeği ile ulaştırma uzantısını birlikte anlatır; özel bağ ucu kullanımı bağlamda ayrıca belirtilir.

error_profile.preserves: Son nokta ile hedefe ulaştırma arasındaki yönlü bağı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kendi son noktasına vardığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Varılan son nokta ve hedef yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi alıcıya ulaştırma eylemini ve bağ ucunu dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal zaman ve mesafe boyunca uzanan sürecin sonuna odaklanır; odak dal daha genel son nokta yanında ulaştırma uzantısı taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İlerleyişin vardığı son nokta ile hedefe ulaştırmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Kötü davranışı tanıyıp kişiyi onu yapmaktan alıkoyan akıl.

concept_gloss.text: kötü davranışı önleyen akıl ve sağduyu

error_profile.preserves: Akıl, ayırt etme ve kötülükten alıkoyma işlevlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişide davranışını frenleyecek zihinsel yetinin bulunup bulunmadığı söylenirken uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aklı, ayırt etmeyi ve yanlış davranış karşısında kendini tutmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal davranışsal freni zorunlu tutar; komşu dalın akıl alanı bilgi ve kavrayışı da bağımsız olarak kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Davranışı ayırt edip frenleyen sağlam zihinsel denetimi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin doğru yargılama ve davranışını yönetme kapasitesini değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal frenleyici aklın varlığını, komşu dal aynı eksende akıl ve ağırbaşlılık yetersizliğini öne çıkarır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gölcük adları ile suyun durması ve vadinin son kesimi için kullanılan yapılar ayrı yüzeyler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Akan suyun veya selin vadi sonunda ulaşıp durulduğu, yayıldığı ve biriktiği doğal gölcük ya da kesimdir; ilgili yapıda suyun burada durup sakinleşmesini de anlatır.

facets.statement: Akışın sonunda suyun durulup biriktiği doğal gölcük.

Suyun gölcükte durması ve hareketini yitirerek sakinleşmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, suyun akış sonunda bir gölcüğe veya vadi kesimine varmasını, orada yayılıp durmasını ve birikmesini tek bir yer-süreç bağı içinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: akış sonunda suyun durulup biriktiği yer

error_profile.preserves: Akış sonu, durulma, birikme ve yer ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun gölcüğe varıp hareketini yitirdiği süreç anlatılırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun durması, sakinleşmesi ve birikmesini korur.
